name: reading-passages-01
description: 10 ảnh bìa hợp dạng bài cho bài đoạn văn Luyện đọc (thay ảnh hai người nói chuyện).

jobs.subject: close still life of a university corridor bulletin board made of cork: one handwritten paper note pinned with two round pins, its writing shown only as soft abstract pencil scribble lines, beside it a small hand-drawn floor sketch of rooms and a staircase arrow; softly blurred bright hallway behind with a staircase going down and a classroom door.

alt.vi: Tờ ghi chú viết tay ghim trên bảng tin hành lang trường đại học.

jobs.subject: still life on a wooden desk by a window at dusk: an open diary notebook with handwriting shown only as abstract ink lines, a museum ticket stub and a small postcard of a landscape painting tucked in the page, a pen and a cup of tea.

alt.vi: Cuốn nhật ký mở trên bàn, kẹp vé bảo tàng và tấm bưu thiếp tranh.

jobs.subject: close view of a hand holding a smartphone whose screen shows a simple chat with three rounded message bubbles of abstract lines and a small bento emoji-like drawing, no readable text; softly blurred university campus courtyard at noon behind.

alt.vi: Bàn tay cầm điện thoại hiện màn hình tin nhắn rủ ăn trưa.

jobs.subject: a small paper flyer lying on a round wooden cafe table next to a cup of coffee: the flyer has a simple drawing of a coffee cup and a cherry blossom branch and abstract lines instead of text; through the window behind, a park with a blooming cherry tree.

alt.vi: Tờ quảng cáo quán cà phê trên bàn, cửa sổ nhìn ra cây anh đào trong công viên.

jobs.subject: morning in front of a small dormitory entrance with a glass door and potted plant: a tiny white kitten sitting inside an open cardboard box on the ground, and a young Vietnamese woman about 19, dark bob hair, cream cardigan over brick-red top crouching down beside the box looking at the kitten with surprise and a gentle smile.

alt.vi: Mai ngồi xuống nhìn chú mèo trắng nhỏ trong thùng giấy trước ký túc xá.

jobs.subject: still life by a window in winter: a notebook open on a desk with an essay shown only as abstract handwriting lines, a warm mug and a scarf; outside the window large soft snowflakes fall over small Japanese houses with white roofs.

alt.vi: Cuốn vở mở cạnh cửa sổ, ngoài trời tuyết đầu mùa đang rơi trên mái nhà.

jobs.subject: close view of a bank ATM front panel: a hand inserting a cash card into the slot, the screen shows only three simple numbered-looking step boxes drawn as abstract shapes and a keypad below, a small receipt slot; calm convenience store interior softly blurred behind.

alt.vi: Bàn tay đưa thẻ vào máy ATM, màn hình chỉ các bước rút tiền.

jobs.subject: still life on a bedside table in a small apartment room: an open laptop whose screen shows an email window with abstract lines and no readable text, a medicine packet, a glass of water, a thermometer and tissues; a bed with a folded blanket softly visible.

alt.vi: Máy tính mở thư điện tử trên bàn đầu giường, cạnh thuốc và nhiệt kế.

jobs.subject: still life on a wooden floor before a weekend trip: a paper hiking itinerary with a simple sketched mountain trail map and abstract lines instead of text, next to a small backpack, a water bottle, two rice balls wrapped in paper and a compact camera.

alt.vi: Tờ lịch trình leo núi cạnh ba lô, chai nước, cơm nắm và máy ảnh.

jobs.subject: still life on a classroom desk by a window: a handmade folded thank-you card with a pressed cherry blossom on its front and abstract handwriting lines inside, an envelope and a small bouquet of flowers; a school building and spring trees outside the window.

alt.vi: Tấm thiệp cảm ơn tự làm, phong bì và bó hoa nhỏ trên bàn học.
